result:
Fixed where the reader was right, kept what the structure needs:

- Removed the redundant parenthetical — "directly holding" plus "(directly in the folder, not in a subfolder)" marked directness twice. One marker ("directly holding") remains, which still unambiguously excludes the subfolder reading.
- Kept the generic "the Campaign folder" instead of exact "Spring Campaign": every witness folder is an X Campaign folder, and each decoy must fail exactly one condition. Naming "Spring Campaign" exactly would make the Summer/Fall/Holiday/Winter decoys fail the name condition on top of their own, breaking all of them (the alternative, five identically-named folders, is far less natural). Referring to "the Campaign folder holding…" is how a user disambiguates among same-scheme folders by content.
